appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: System mode automatically follows your device’s light or dark appearance.
appearance.label: App appearance
habits.connectHelp: Choose a Google Sheet or create one in Settings.
habits.emptyHelp: Add something you want to make time for every day.
habits.calendar: Habit calendar, scroll horizontally for more dates
habits.caption: Daily habits, from {from} to {to}
habits.name: Habit name
habits.clearHelp: An empty field clears the saved value.
habits.renameHelp: The new name applies to every day. Existing records stay intact.
habits.deleteHelp: This deletes the habit and all its records across every day. Other habits stay intact.
habits.saveFailed: Could not save the habit. Please retry.
habits.valueFailed: Could not save the value. Please retry.
workouts.emptyHelp: Add your first exercise and record your sets.
workouts.caption: Sets for {name} on {date}
workouts.renameHelp: The new name applies to every day. Existing sets stay intact.
workouts.deleteHelp: All sets for this exercise on {date} will be deleted. Other days stay intact.
workouts.duplicateDay: This exercise is already on this day. Add more sets from its card.
workouts.saveFailed: Could not save the workout. Please retry; your sets are still in the form.
workouts.name: Exercise name
workouts.moreHelp: Fill in the empty row to add another set. Empty rows are not saved.
workouts.clearHelp: Saving without sets removes this exercise from the selected day.
manage.gesture: Click to edit; on a touch screen, hold the name
settings.offlineHelp: Connect and sign in to Google to change spreadsheets. You can keep editing local records.
settings.separate: Habits and workouts use separate spreadsheets. Changing a connection does not delete or move existing data.
settings.accessHelp: These spreadsheets are already accessible to the app.
settings.empty: No available spreadsheets. Create one or use a link.
settings.linkHelp: Links work for spreadsheets the app already has permission to access.
settings.habitTabs: The Habits and HabitDefinitions tabs will be used. Missing tabs will be created.
settings.workoutTabs: The Workouts tab will be used. It will be created if missing.
settings.success: Spreadsheet connected. Existing data stays intact.
settings.rememberFailed: Spreadsheet connected, but this browser could not remember your choice for the next sign-in.
local.title: Local records
local.help: Edits save in this browser first. They upload to Google Sheets in the background when you are connected and signed in.
local.pendingHelp: These spreadsheets still have pending changes. Even after switching connections, edits upload to their original spreadsheet.
local.backupHelp: The backup includes unsent edits. Clearing this site’s browser data deletes its local records.
sync.retained: Unsent changes remain in this browser.
install.label: App installation
install.title: Fero Tracker on your home screen
install.description: Open your tracker with one tap, even offline after the first load.
install.error: Use your browser’s menu to install the app, following the steps below.
install.how: How to add the app to your home screen
install.apple: open this page in Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen. If Open as Web App is shown, keep it enabled.
install.android: in Chrome, open the ⋮ menu → Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.help: First sign-in and loading spreadsheets need internet. To upload offline edits, open the app with a connection and sign in to Google.
